kind: Measurement-boundary clarification from frozen source inspection; no timing source or preregistered gate changed
inputMethod: Programmatic DOM Event dispatch and HTMLElement.click with native value/checked preparation, plus the explicitly documented dirty/equal probes. This exercises actual TaskApp handlers in a real browser; it is not a physical keyboard or trusted-user-event latency measurement, and does not test a native IME.
primaryMs: Immediately before dispatch() closure entry through primary flush/Effect and the following microtask. Includes target lookup for counter, move, delete, add, and existing setter lookup for dirty. It does not start at a separately recorded native event-delivery timestamp.

includedAdapterWork.counter: querySelectorAll(button), array conversion and text lookup
includedAdapterWork.move: querySelectorAll(button), array conversion and text lookup

outsidePrimary: Independent model update, identity map, focus/selection preparation and oracle. Input/search/rename/filter/sort/toggle target lookup and native value/checked preparation are outside.
totalCpuMs: Elapsed primary window plus disjoint follow-up flush/effect windows; not OS thread CPU time or pure engine-only execution. Explicit 40ms timer delay excluded. Nested phase intervals not added.
settledMs: Same dispatch-closure start through the actual asynchronous Effect follow-up, including the deliberate timer delay and any included dispatch-helper lookup; ends before the semantic oracle.
initialization: cpuMs sums actual mount, data-injection and sync-follow-up flush/effect intervals. Model construction, data-copy/dispatch overhead, root constructor and complete disposal cost are not included in this sum.
initializationElapsedMs: Starts immediately before the default app mount and ends after the sync follow-up, before the oracle. Includes data copy/dispatch and actual timer waits; excludes earlier independent-model/root construction and later disposal.
updateCount: Workload cycles; CRUD has five user actions, other workloads one. Not root-render or flush count.
visualDiagnostics: A separate direct click boundary with the trigger located before the clock. Do not pool or directly equate its absolute latency with formal primaryMs.
interpretation: All six combinations use the same frozen harness and definitions. Comparisons include this common adapter overhead; report internal render/diff/commit separately. Do not relabel formal totals as pure engine or physical display latency.
